President Donald Trump ordered new airstrikes against Iran following a ballistic missile and drone attack in Jordan that killed two U.S. service members and left one missing.

The administration is using direct military force to re-establish a boundary. By responding immediately to the loss of life, they attempt to project strength to prevent further aggression, balancing deterrence against escalation.

The Trajectory: The Path of Redemption.

The Unavoidable Truth: Military deterrence requires credible action when red lines are crossed.

The Unavoidable Lie: The belief that military strikes alone can permanently resolve deep geopolitical conflicts.
